'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Warrior! Remember the DB you were building? I couldn't deliver it past the border. That's a bummer, the shotty is gorgeous. Speaking of, we've got plenty of demons of our own in Tarkov. Can't even take a shit in the woods at night! Why don't you take this gun out for a spin and deal with those devils?}}

==Requirements==
* This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 3 [[Cultists|hooded men]] while using the [[MP-43-1C 12ga double-barrel shotgun|double barrel shotgun]]

==Rewards==
* +16,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 324,000 Roubles
** 340,200 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 372,600 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 3× [[VOG-25 Khattabka improvised hand grenade]]
* 3× [[RGN hand grenade]]
* 3× [[RGO hand grenade]]
{{quote|How'd it go? We really should add something like that to the inventory... I think it's gonna be a big hit!}}
